message: Damn.  What a nightmare - I live in Canada, and my boyfriend is in Illinois in jail.  He tried to phone my house today - but its blocking collect calls... he was able to get a hold of me on my cell with a phone card and told me to contact T Netix about the block.  I'm kinda freaked out to phone and set up an account when everyone on here has been ripped off by these jerks.  Good luck to all of you.
